// NOTE: This is an example configuration file showing all available options with detailed comments
// USAGE: Copy this to appsettings.Development.json and fill in your actual values

Agent.// SystemPrompt: The system prompt sent to the LLM at the start of every conversation
Agent.SystemPrompt: You are a helpful AI assistant with expertise in software development.
Agent.// ContextWindowSize: Maximum number of messages to keep in LLM context (older messages are truncated but remain visible in UI)

LLM.// Provider: Which LLM provider to use: 'AzureOpenAI' or 'Anthropic' (both fully supported)
LLM.// Temperature: Controls randomness (0.0 = deterministic, 2.0 = very random). Recommended: 0.7
LLM.// MaxTokens: Maximum tokens in LLM response. Recommended: 4096

AzureOpenAI.// Endpoint: Your Azure OpenAI resource endpoint (e.g., https://your-resource.openai.azure.com/)
AzureOpenAI.// ApiKey: Your Azure OpenAI API key (find in Azure Portal under Keys and Endpoint)
AzureOpenAI.// DeploymentName: The name of your deployed model in Azure OpenAI Studio
AzureOpenAI.// ApiVersion: Azure OpenAI API version. Use latest stable version.

Anthropic.// ApiKey: Your Anthropic API key (get from https://console.anthropic.com/)

MCP.// Enabled: Enable MCP tool integration (false until Phase 5)
MCP.// ServerPaths: Array of paths to MCP server executables
